__broaden__.αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός)
__broaden__.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’)
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a negative statement with a relative clause: οὐδὲ γένηται ’nor ever shall there be’
__broaden__.εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’ · also with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took away from’ (ἐκ … εἵλετο)
__broaden__.κῦμ: κῦμα — wave; neut. acc. sg., elided (κῦμ’ = κῦμα), object of ἀποέργει: ‘the wave’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: κῦμ’ ἐφόρει ’a wave bore (me)’
__broaden__.λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. used imperativally: ’beseech (him)!’ · also pres. inf. as a complement in apposition after δοάσσατο κέρδιον εἶναι: ’to beseech’
__broaden__.μένε: μένος — might, vigor, strength; neut. acc. pl. μένεα, elided μένε(’) before a vowel: ’the men’s strength’ (κατέφθιτο ... μένε’ ἀνδρῶν) · also μένω — stay, hold one’s ground; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμενε): ’she stayed, stood firm’
__broaden__.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’
__broaden__.μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl. μήδεα · also the genitals (of the body): περὶ χροῒ μήδεα φωτός ’the man’s genitals, about the skin’; neut. acc. pl.
__broaden__.οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
__broaden__.πάθω: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’what am I to suffer?’ (τί πάθω) · also aor. subj. 1 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may suffer’
__broaden__.περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’)
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’)
__broaden__.σκέπας: σκέπας — shelter, cover; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., ’shelter’ as goal of motion (ἐπὶ σκέπας)
__broaden__.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
__broaden__.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’
__broaden__.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’
__broaden__.φύγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 pl., no augment (= ἔφυγον) · also aor. 1 sg. (same ending as 3 pl.): ’I fled’
__broaden__.ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., address: ’handmaids!’
__broaden__.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
__broaden__.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’
__broaden__.ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς) · also ’on which’, of a road: τὴν ὁδὸν ᾗ δὴ ’the journey on which’
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’
